entries.what: Jun works his Tue-Fri schedule off, so Monday starts slow: he sleeps in at his Vinca fourplex sublet, then preps filling at home and counts wrapper stock for the week's batches.
entries.outcome: Wrapper count written in Linh's sheet; enough cases for the week.

entries.what: Buys pork and shrimp for Thanksgiving preorders at Ruiz Family Market and fills up at the Ruel Road station.
entries.outcome: Spent under his weekly budget and logged receipts right away.

entries.what: Texts Paolo the market setup call time for the coming Sunday and Paolo thumbs-ups it.
entries.outcome: Setup time confirmed with no back and forth.

entries.what: Opens Heron & Grind at 6:15, pulling shots for the morning rush and training Linh on a tricky tulip pour between orders.
entries.outcome: Linh lands her first clean tulip.

entries.what: Eats a late al pastor lunch at Taquería Colima after his shift, then goes over preorder list with Tess by phone.
entries.outcome: Tess adds six more dozen orders from coworkers.

entries.what: Evening at home rolling a test batch of turon while OPM ballads play on the speaker.
entries.outcome: Turon filling tweaked; decides to try it again Saturday.

entries.what: Opening shift at the cafe; Wes says his 7 a.m. cortado tasted flat, so Jun pulls test shots and adjusts the grind before the rush ends.
entries.outcome: Wes gets a remade cortado and says it's better; Jun still wants to dial the new blend in properly.
entries.feeling: fussy, wants to get it right

entries.what: On break he asks the assistant how to dial in the new bean blend after Wes's comment, then goes back to the bar.
entries.outcome: Gets a short list of grind and dose adjustments to try tomorrow.

entries.what: After work he labels freezer bags for Thanksgiving pickup preorders at the fourplex.
entries.outcome: Forty dozen worth of bags labeled and stacked.

entries.what: Opens the cafe again and uses the adjusted grind; the morning cortados come out smooth.
entries.outcome: Sam texts about swapping Saturday, and Jun says yes.

entries.what: Drops by the Ruel Road commissary to check Friday's block timing and talks with Joan about fryer cleanup.
entries.outcome: Reminded of the $40 fee; plans extra scrub time.

entries.what: Evening he updates Linh's sheet with sales and kitchen hours and sends Linh a thank-you for the week.
entries.outcome: Sheet balanced, totals match.

entries.what: Opens Heron & Grind for his last shift of the week, serving the Friday regulars.
entries.outcome: Beatrice's corgi Ledger naps by the register and the shift ends on time.

entries.what: Friday 5-9 p.m. commissary block: Jun and Paolo roll and fry large preorder batches.
entries.outcome: About 300 lumpia made and the fryer area scrubbed so no fee.

entries.what: Late dinner of tacos with Paolo on Calle Ortega after the kitchen.
entries.outcome: They talk through Sunday's setup.

entries.what: Saturday table at the Heron & Grind counter, selling lumpia to regulars including Wes with his quarters.
entries.outcome: Sold out of the batch by early afternoon.

entries.what: Afternoon he bags frozen preorders at home and passes some to Tess for her coworkers.
entries.outcome: Tess approves of the batch with no onion comment.

entries.what: Passes the food drive crowds near Our Lady of the Marsh on the drive home, with a donation of lumpia trays dropped off for volunteers.
entries.outcome: Dropped a tray at the parish table.

entries.what: Sunday market at Delgado Park: sets up the stall under the canopy with Paolo and sells lumpia all morning.
entries.outcome: Stall busy and most of the batch sold.

entries.what: Tess stops by the stall, buys a half dozen and checks the wrappers silently.
entries.outcome: No complaints, which Jun counts as praise.

entries.what: Evening tallying market sales into Linh's sheet and planning next week's Thanksgiving prep.
entries.outcome: Sales logged; prep list for Wednesday made.
